title: Nashville Getaway and Fun Trip
description:
Steeped in Southern traditions of hospitality and charm, you’ll want for nothing as you adventure day and night in Music City. Luckily, this warm, friendly resort is close to Nashville’s best music, liquor, and historical landmarks.
Located just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry. Conveniently located near popular destinations like the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum and the Nashville Zoo, you can easily explore all that Nashville has to offer.
